name: NavDB Studio
subtitle: SQL & NoSQL database client
promotionalText: One fast, native app for 30 database engines: browse data, write SQL with smart autocomplete and design tables.
description:
NavDB Studio is a fast, native database client for developers, analysts and DBAs. Connect to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch and 20 more engines from one app.

EXPLORE AND EDIT DATA
• Navigator for connections, databases, schemas, tables, views, functions and more
• Spreadsheet-style data grid with paging, inline editing and transactional Apply / Discard
• Visual filter builder, multi-column sort, form view and a cell editor for large text and JSON

WRITE SQL FASTER
• Syntax highlighting, multiple result tabs, EXPLAIN, beautify and minify
• Context-aware autocomplete: tables after FROM and JOIN, columns of aliased tables, CTE columns and dialect functions
• Ready-made JOIN conditions from foreign keys, parameter hints and hover info
• Snippets, saved queries and query history

DESIGN
• Table designer for columns, indexes, foreign keys, checks and triggers with a live SQL preview
• Designers for views, functions, procedures, triggers and sequences

IMPORT AND EXPORT
• Import CSV, TSV, JSON and XML
• Export CSV, JSON, XML, HTML, Markdown, SQL and Excel
• Dump to SQL, backup and restore, test-data generation

NAVDB STUDIO PRO
The free version includes up to two saved connections with the full editor, data grid and designers. A Pro subscription adds:
• Unlimited saved connections
• Data Transfer between connections and engines
• Structure Sync and Data Sync with a reviewable script
• ER model diagrams
• Charts and dashboards
• Automation: scheduled queries, backups and exports

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Privacy: NavDB Studio collects no data. Your connections stay on your Mac.
